description: This file defines an index router for a trading platform, including several command functions to fetch index data, snapshots, available indices, search for indices, and get index sectors, utilizing a router framework and external data sources.

methods.name: OBBject constituents( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Fetches the constituents of an index based on provider and parameters.

methods.name: OBBject snapshots( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Retrieves current index snapshots grouped by region for a provider.

methods.name: OBBject available( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Lists all available indices from a specified provider.

methods.name: OBBject search( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Filters indices containing a specific query string.

methods.name: OBBject sp500_multiples( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Provides historical S&P 500 multiples and Shiller PE ratios.

methods.name: OBBject sectors( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Gets sector weightings of an index.
